notes: Published title 'Surprise @#$%' contains a masked swear, so the page uses the player name instead; the published title stays in the source citation.
The post is tagged Light and every card is Light; the draft's Dark side was corrected.

Starting cards as posted under START: Heading For The Medical Frigate, Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice, Battle Plan and Ultimatum; all counted. No Objective or starting location; starting.effect left empty because three Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect.

Section headers (DESTINY SEVEN, DESTINY SIX, USEFUL FIVES, DROIDS, LOCATIONS, START, <OTHER>) were mis-parsed as cards and removed; the destiny notes after the droids ('- d5' etc.) are not part of the names.

Posted 'Hoth MPG's' dested Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker); 'Hoth 4th Marker' dested Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker); 'Shoo Shoo' dested Shoo! Shoo!; 'A Few Manuvers' dested A Few Maneuvers; 'DODN/ Wise Advice' dested Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; 'Anger, Fear, Agression' dested Anger, Fear, Aggression.
The list totals 62 cards as published.
The strategy says the deck beat an opponent by 30-some at 'state' (an unnamed state championship, no finish given); kept as a general deck.
